subject: Request to erase single conversation record (REQ-GLF-4427)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2028-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to remove a single conversation from logs - REQ-GLF-4427

Hi Karthik,

We are running an internal audit and need Redwood's assistance to remove one specific conversation from your telemetry/audit logs for our account (Greenleaf Health). This is a targeted request: do not alter other records.

Details: the conversation contains PHI references that were inadvertently captured in a support thread on 2027-11-02. The thread includes a small set of messages between our security contact and your support rep. We have attached the data_request form and a redacted export showing the message IDs we want removed.

Request ID: REQ-GLF-4427
Message IDs: msg-20271102-15A, msg-20271102-15B
Preferred outcome: remove the conversation from any logs that would cause it to appear in usage telemetry, audit exports, or retained debug traces. Please confirm the scope of work, what artifacts you will remove, and provide written confirmation when the removal is complete.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Security Operations
Greenleaf Health

Attachments referenced: greenleaf_data_request.pdf, redacted-thread-export.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to remove a single conversation from logs - REQ-GLF-4427

Elena — thanks for the clear request and the exported IDs. I will coordinate with our Platform Compliance and infra teams. A few quick clarifying points so we scope this correctly: 

1) Confirm you only want the single conversation (msg-20271102-15A/B) removed from our telemetry/audit exports and any backing storage used for debugging. We will not modify customer data stored in your dedicated customer workspace (if applicable) unless explicitly requested.
2) We will need a signed request form (the greenleaf_data_request.pdf you attached looks fine) plus a primary contact for verification once the work completes.

Planned steps (high level):
- Compliance team validates the request and matches the message IDs against retention/replication lanes.
- Infra executes a targeted purge from index and telemetry stores and marks the event as suppressed from future exports.
- Platform Ops produces an evidence package (redacted audit log snippet and internal job id) and notifies you with a confirmation email and a retention-change manifest.

Can Monica and Laura stay looped for the ops handoff? Monica — can you pick this up and run the checklist in 24–48h? Laura — please capture the verification artifact and the internal job id.

Karthik
VP, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-03-11T08:27:00-07:00

Karthik — confirmed. We only want the two message IDs listed purged from your telemetry and any debugging/trace artifacts. The signed PDF is attached to this thread (greenleaf_data_request.pdf). Primary verification contact: elena@greenleafhealth.com. You have authorization to proceed.

Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodhealth.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-12T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to remove a single conversation from logs - REQ-GLF-4427

Hi Elena — quick update and confirmation.

Work completed: targeted suppression job run against telemetry index and debug archives for the two message IDs you supplied. We removed the entries from the following artifacts: audit export index (idx-audit-03), debug traces (trace-store-1), and our internal developer telemetry cache (dev-cache-2).

Evidence provided: attached is a redacted verification package (audit-snippet-redacted.txt) showing the pre- and post-state for msg-20271102-15A/B, and an internal job id you can reference: job-REM-20280312-791. We have also updated our internal retention manifest: https://docs.redwood.com/retention/surgical-removals#job-REM-20280312-791

Notes/limitations: 
- This operation removes the conversation from NewRelic-like telemetry and our internal debug traces and prevents it from appearing in future platform exports.
- Backups older than our rollback window (30 days) may still contain copies; we listed backup lanes that were examined in the attached audit snippet. Per policy, we cannot mutate cold immutable backups without a separate request — we can provide a timeline for a more extensive archival purge if needed.

If the deliverable meets your needs, reply with written acceptance and we'll close REQ-GLF-4427. If you want further actions (e.g., archival purge), we can open a scoped change request and provide timelines/cost.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Platform Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
